stops.note: the plural word for stairs or a ladder
kept the sense of a ladder
named a single rung, then a step-like, staggered arrangement of troops
stops.meaning: a rung; a staggered troop formation

stops.note: entered for the military formation, later widened to any level or rank within a hierarchy
stops.meaning: a level or rank within an organization

current_meaning: a level or rank within an organization or hierarchy
